cards.title: Lieutenant Cecius (V)
issues: Missing clause: at battlegrounds where you have a unique and a non-unique Imperial present (and no other Force drain bonus), your Force drains are +1.

review.blocked_on: Engine support for a conditional Force drain bonus that applies only when no other Force drain bonus applies (no precedent on master, no PR in the review set).
review.notes: Deploy +1 for opponent's characters at same mobile site and Tactical Support as Used Interrupt are fine.

pc_front.gametext: Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other bonus to your Force drain), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.
pc_front.lore: Former member of the Imperial infantry. Specializes in boarding and taking control of enemy ships. Native of Vogel 7. Hasn't had a date in years.
pc_front.title: •Lieutenant Cecius (V)

title: Implement independent Captain Mod Terrik clauses (Legacy Lane A)

cards.title: Captain Mod Terrik
issues: Missing clause: your ability-1 troopers (unless they have another forfeit bonus) are forfeit +2.

review.blocked_on: Engine query to test 'has another forfeit bonus' without recursion (no precedent on master, no PR in review set).
review.notes: Stats/armor/keywords, other sandtroopers deploy -1, ability-1 trooper forfeit-reduction protection, two-trooper battle destiny fine.

pc_front.gametext: Other sandtroopers are deploy -1. Your ability-1 troopers may not have their forfeit reduced and (unless they have another forfeit bonus) are forfeit +2. At sites where you have two troopers, they may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
pc_front.lore: Leader. Captain Mod Terrik, a typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. Fearless and highly motivated. Willing to sacrifice as many troops as necessary.
pc_front.title: •Captain Mod Terrik
